note: Structural companion to ts6-emit-baseline.json, which stays the raw byte record. Declarations are compared by canonical shape; maps by attribution and coverage. Exact-byte surfaces are checked against the raw baseline, not against this file.

declarationOrdering.appliedBy: command line only, at capture; never in a tsconfig or a package script
declarationOrdering.why: TypeScript 7 orders type members deterministically. Asking TypeScript 6 for that ordering makes the two comparable WITHOUT a comparator that reorders anything, so declaration order stays meaning — which it is, for overload resolution.

supersedes.status: HISTORICAL. It is the first implementation's evidence and stays byte-identical. It is NOT current comparison authority: its declaration shapes were canonicalized by sorting object-type members, which erases overload order.
